title: Climate Change and Water

article.heading: Introduction
article.paragraph: Climate change is no longer a distant threat. It is a present reality that affects ecosystems, communities, and the availability of vital resources. Among the most critical of these resources is water.

article.heading: Changing Rainfall Patterns
article.paragraph: Over the past few decades, scientists have observed shifts in rainfall distribution around the world. Some regions are experiencing prolonged droughts, while others face intense flooding.

article.heading: Rising Temperatures
article.paragraph: Higher temperatures increase the rate of evaporation from lakes, rivers, and soil. Even if rainfall levels remain the same, the net water availability decreases.

vocabulary.example: Climate change is a present reality.
Prolonged droughts can threaten food production.
Net water availability may decrease even when rainfall stays the same.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Climate change is no longer a distant threat. It is a present reality that affects ecosystems, communities, and the availability of vital resources.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 기후 변화는 더 이상 먼 미래의 위협이 아니다. 기후 변화는 생태계와 공동체, 그리고 필수 자원의 이용 가능성에 영향을 미치는 현재의 현실이다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: no longer A는 더 이상 A가 아니라는 뜻입니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Some regions are experiencing prolonged droughts, while others face intense flooding.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 일부 지역은 장기간의 가뭄을 겪는 반면, 다른 지역은 심각한 홍수에 직면하고 있다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: while은 서로 다른 두 상황을 대조할 때 사용합니다.

sentence_interpretations.sentence: Even if rainfall levels remain the same, the net water availability decreases.
sentence_interpretations.translation: 강우량이 같은 수준으로 유지되더라도 실제로 이용 가능한 물의 양은 감소한다.
sentence_interpretations.learning_note: even if는 어떤 조건을 가정하더라도 결과가 달라지지 않음을 나타냅니다.

conversation_questions.question: How does climate change affect water availability in your country?
conversation_questions.sample_answer: Changing rainfall patterns are making water management more difficult in my country.
conversation_questions.coaching_point: Use due to or because of to explain a cause.

conversation_questions.question: How can individuals help reduce water waste during dry seasons?
conversation_questions.sample_answer: People can reuse water whenever possible and avoid unnecessary consumption.
conversation_questions.coaching_point: Use can plus the base verb to describe practical actions.

conversation_questions.question: What policies could help communities manage climate-related water challenges?
conversation_questions.sample_answer: Water reuse technologies and better infrastructure could help communities adapt.
conversation_questions.coaching_point: Use could to suggest possible solutions politely.

audio_script: Climate change is no longer a distant threat. It is a present reality that affects ecosystems, communities, and the availability of vital resources. Among the most critical of these resources is water. Over the past few decades, scientists have observed shifts in rainfall distribution around the world. Some regions are experiencing prolonged droughts, while others face intense flooding. Higher temperatures increase the rate of evaporation from lakes, rivers, and soil. Even if rainfall levels remain the same, the net water availability decreases.
